threshold_rule.verbatim_text: Decreto 174/2024, artículo 5: “Solo las universidades del Estado con un mínimo de acreditación institucional de nivel avanzado de cinco años”. Ley 21.325, artículo 143: “las universidades del Estado con un mínimo de cinco años de acreditación tendrán la atribución de reconocer y revalidar títulos y grados académicos”.
threshold_rule.interpretation: For professional titles and academic degrees, the complete test is: (1) a STATE university; (2) a current institutional accreditation award of at least five years; and (3) at least the advanced level. CNA's scale is “6 o 7 años en el caso de la acreditación de excelencia, de 4 o 5 años en la acreditación avanzada y de 3 años en la acreditación básica” (https://www.cnachile.cl/SiteAssets/Paginas/Acreditacion-institucional/DO_AI.pdf). Consequently, advanced/4 years fails, advanced/5 passes, and excellence/6–7 passes. “Five years of advanced accreditation” is therefore a substantially correct shorthand for the minimum, but misleading if it suggests that every advanced accreditation qualifies or that excellence does not. Private universities are excluded for professional titles and academic degrees; Decreto 174 permits qualifying private institutions only for technical titles. Article 4 adds the subject-specific restriction “carreras o programas afines a los que impartan, que al menos cuenten con una cohorte de titulados o graduados” (https://www.diariooficial.interior.gob.cl/publicaciones/2026/02/17/44378/01/2769106.pdf). For Medicine, the university's Medicina program must also be accredited because Médico Cirujano is subject to mandatory program accreditation: “deberán someterse obligatoriamente al proceso de acreditación” (https://www.cnachile.cl/noticias/SiteAssets/Paginas/Forms/AllItems/Reglamento%20para%20el%20desarrollo%20de%20procesos%20de%20acreditaci%C3%B3n%20obligatoria%20de%20carreras%20y%20programas%20de%20pregrado.pdf). Universidad de Chile's professional-title/degree route continues under its own statute; Decreto 174 says that, for UChile, the new regulation applies only to technical titles and curricular convalidation.

universities.name: UNIVERSIDAD DE CHILE
universities.quote: UChile: “fue acreditada en nivel de excelencia por 7 años (2025-2032)”. Ingresa: “23/12/2025 - 23/12/2032”.
universities.revalidation_notes: This is a functioning, applicant-facing procedure covering foreign professional titles and academic degrees. UChile says recognition “Aplica principalmente para posgrados, como magister o doctorados”; her medical title would normally be a revalidation application and her PhD a separate recognition application. Its January 2026 public register includes “Revalidación del título profesional de MÉDICO CIRUJANO” (https://uchile.cl/presentacion/informacion-publica/rev0126). The checklist accepts “Cédula de identidad chilena o pasaporte”, so an initial digital application appears possible from Ukraine without a Chilean identity card; no visa or residency requirement is listed. However, originals are later checked at a “cita presencial”, so it is not demonstrably end-to-end remote. The instructions require “Arancel de Ingreso (2 UTM)”, payment “desde una cuenta chilena”, although “Si la transferencia es realizada por un tercero” is expressly contemplated (https://uchile.cl/dam/jcr%3Aaf663407-f14e-4d0e-be0f-df0840357f0c/Instructivo%20de%20Ingreso%20al%20proceso%20de%20Revalidaci%26oacute%3Bn%20y%20Reconocimiento.pdf). She should confirm both proposed applications before paying.

universities.name: UNIVERSIDAD DE VALPARAISO
universities.quote: UV: “acreditación institucional en el nivel de excelencia por 6 años”. Ingresa: “08/03/2023 - 08/03/2029”.
universities.revalidation_notes: No published procedure found. Live searches of uv.cl found no post-17-August-2026 applicant regulation, Unidad Coordinadora, filing form, fee instructions, or revalidation-specific contact. Therefore there is no published basis for saying that it currently accepts Medicina applications or applications from abroad.

universities.name: UNIVERSIDAD DE O'HIGGINS
universities.quote: UOH: “una acreditación avanzada de cuatro años”. Ingresa: “19/04/2023 - 19/04/2027”.
universities.revalidation_notes: No published procedure found, and the university fails Decreto 174's five-year institutional threshold. A generic organizational page says “La Prorrectoría también resuelve el reconocimiento de estudios y revalidación o convalidación de títulos profesionales obtenidos en el extranjero” (https://www.uoh.cl/universidad/prorrectoria/), but it supplies no procedure or intake channel and cannot override article 5. The university's own council minutes recognized the problem: “les faltó un año de acreditación para poder hacerlo” (https://www.uoh.cl/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/Acta-Consejo-Superior-30-de-septiembre-de-2025.pdf?x71539=). It cannot presently accept her Medicina or PhD applications under the new route.

universities.name: UNIVERSIDAD DE TALCA
universities.quote: UTalca: “7 años de acreditación institucional” and “institución de excelencia”. Ingresa: “01/06/2026 - 01/06/2033”.
universities.revalidation_notes: No published procedure found. Live searches of utalca.cl found no applicant-facing post-17-August-2026 regulation, Unidad Coordinadora, form, fee/payment instructions, or revalidation-specific contact. There is consequently no published confirmation that Medicina is open for intake or that an applicant in Ukraine can file.

universities.name: UNIVERSIDAD DE SANTIAGO DE CHILE
universities.quote: CNA: “acreditar en el nivel de excelencia a la Universidad de Santiago de Chile […] plazo de siete años”. Ingresa: “25/02/2021 - 25/02/2028”.
universities.revalidation_notes: No published procedure found. USACH reported in May 2026 that officials reviewed “reconocimiento y revalidación de títulos extranjeros” (https://www.contraloria.usach.cl/node/520), but that is not an intake procedure. Its still-live personnel page instead says “la revalidación o reconocimiento deberá realizarse en la Universidad de Chile” (https://vrifyl.usach.cl/contratacion-de-personal/). No public Unidad Coordinadora, application form, Medicina instructions, overseas-applicant rule, or revalidation-specific contact was found.

universities.name: UNIVERSIDAD DE LA FRONTERA
universities.quote: UFRO: “Acreditación Institucional en Nivel Avanzado […] proyección a cinco años […] 2025–2030”. Ingresa: “03/09/2025 - 03/09/2030”.
universities.revalidation_notes: No published procedure found. Live searches of ufro.cl found only services for certificates issued by UFRO—for example, “certificados de títulos o grados” at https://www.ufro.cl/solicitud-de-certificados-estudiantes/—not a foreign-title recognition/revalidation intake. No public evidence was found that Medicina applications or applications from abroad are being accepted.

universities.name: UNIVERSIDAD DE ANTOFAGASTA
universities.quote: UA: “Acreditada en nivel de avanzado […] plazo de 5 años […] hasta el 7 de septiembre del 2027”. Ingresa: “07/09/2022 - 07/09/2027”.
universities.revalidation_notes: No published procedure found. A 2024 transparency response—predating the new regime—states that the university “no dispone de instancias para el reconocimiento y validación de títulos profesionales obtenidos en el Extranjero” (https://transparencia.uantof.cl/index.php?a=2024&action=plantillas_generar_archivo&ia=9996&ig=85&m=7). Live searches found no post-17-August-2026 replacement, Medicina intake, overseas-applicant rule, or revalidation-specific contact.

universities.name: UNIVERSIDAD DE MAGALLANES
universities.quote: UMAG: “está acreditada nivel avanzado hasta el 31 de diciembre de 2028”. Ingresa: “31/12/2023 - 31/12/2028”.
universities.revalidation_notes: No published procedure found. A January 2026 UMAG administrative procedure still cites the requirement for foreign-title recognition/revalidation “ante la Universidad de Chile” (https://umag.cl/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Resolucion-exenta-N26-procedimiento-de-los-convenios-a-honorarios.pdf). The CNA Medicina register presently marks UMAG's Medicine accreditation “In progress(*)” and explains that existing accreditation is extended until the final decision (https://www.cnachile.cl/Paginas/medicina.aspx). No public Medicina intake or rule accepting applicants abroad was found.

universities.name: UNIVERSIDAD DE ATACAMA
universities.quote: UDA: “obtuvo 5 años de acreditación institucional […] nivel avanzado”. Ingresa: “01/04/2026 - 01/04/2031”.
universities.revalidation_notes: No published procedure found. UDA's 2026 normative compilation contains procedures for curricular validation by enrolled students—“Quienes tengan la calidad de estudiante regular […] presentarán su solicitud de convalidación”—not recognition/revalidation of an already-awarded foreign title (https://uda.cl/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/libro-cmpjur27012026.pdf). No public Medicina/PhD intake, overseas-applicant rule, or revalidation-specific contact was found.

universities.name: UNIVERSIDAD DE TARAPACA
universities.quote: UTA: “CNA acredita por 6 años, en nivel de excelencia, a la Universidad de Tarapacá”. Ingresa: “22/06/2023 - 22/06/2029”.
universities.revalidation_notes: No published procedure found. Its public trámite directory describes apostille validation and curricular transfer, including “Validación para Apostillar Documentos”, but not foreign-title recognition/revalidation (https://www.uta.cl/transparencia/tramites/). A July 2026 transparency entry mentions “reuniones […] sobre revalidación de títulos extranjeros” (https://www.uta.cl/transparencia/actos_resoluciones/transparencia/2026/Julio/), which shows preparation rather than an operating intake. No public Medicina procedure or overseas-applicant rule was found.

universities.name: UNIVERSIDAD DEL BIO-BIO
universities.quote: UBB: “nivel avanzado […] por un período de cinco años”. Ingresa: “15/01/2025 - 15/01/2030”.
universities.revalidation_notes: No published procedure found. More importantly for this doctor, UBB cannot yet satisfy Decreto 174 article 4's Medicina graduate-cohort condition: in March 2024 it welcomed “la primera generación de estudiantes de la Escuela de Medicina” (https://noticias.ubiobio.cl/2024/03/01/gore-de-nuble-y-ubb-dan-bienvenida-a-primera-generacion-de-medicina/). Thus, even though UBB meets the institutional threshold, it cannot currently process a Médico Cirujano title. No overseas-applicant procedure or revalidation-specific contact was found.

universities.name: UNIVERSIDAD DE LA SERENA
universities.quote: CNA: “acreditar a la Universidad de La Serena en el nivel avanzado […] plazo de 5 años”. Ingresa: “03/11/2021 - 03/11/2026”.
universities.revalidation_notes: No published procedure found. ULS also cannot currently satisfy article 4 for Medicina: in March 2026 it was preparing to receive “la primera cohorte de estudiantes de Medicina” (https://userena.cl/actualidad/8203-comunicado-sobre-inicio-de-la-carrera-de-medicina-2026.html), so it has no medical graduates. Its still-published study regulation says “La atribución de la revalidación […] corresponde a la Universidad de Chile” (https://vra.userena.cl/media/documentos/reglamento_de_estudios_2010.pdf). No overseas-applicant intake or revalidation-specific contact was found.

universities.name: UNIVERSIDAD DE LOS LAGOS
universities.quote: CNA: “acreditar a la Universidad de Los Lagos en el nivel avanzado […] plazo de 5 años”. Ingresa: “09/09/2021 - 09/09/2026”.
universities.revalidation_notes: No published procedure found. Its institutional accreditation still meets the threshold on 3 September 2026 but expires six days later. It also cannot currently satisfy article 4 for Medicina: its new medical degree “comenzará a impartirse desde este 2026” (https://www.ulagos.cl/2025/11/ulagos-presenta-la-nueva-carrera-de-medicina-en-osorno/), so there is no graduate cohort. No Medicina/PhD intake, overseas-applicant rule, or revalidation-specific contact was found.

bottom_line: As of 3 September 2026, twelve of the thirteen institutions meet the institutional threshold; Universidad de O'Higgins does not. That legal empowerment does not create a place to file. Universidad del Bío-Bío, Universidad de La Serena, and Universidad de Los Lagos additionally cannot handle Médico Cirujano yet because their new Medicina programs have no graduate cohort. At the other non-UChile universities, extensive live searches found no published post-17-August applicant procedure, Unidad Coordinadora, application form, fees, Medicina instructions, overseas-applicant rule, or revalidation-specific contact. Universidad de Chile is therefore still, in practice, the only demonstrably working route for her today. Its published process accepts a passport and digital document upload, making an initial filing from Ukraine appear feasible, but payment needs Chilean infrastructure or a third party and original documents are later checked at an in-person appointment. She should email contactorevalidacion@uchile.cl before paying and identify two separate objectives: revalidation as Médico Cirujano and recognition of her Doctor/PhD degree.
unknowns: A negative open-web search cannot exclude an unpublished internal pilot or a procedure available only through an intranet or on direct request. No non-UChile university published enough information to treat such a possibility as an actual filing route on 3 September 2026.

CNA's institutional search interface is JavaScript-driven and does not expose stable per-result URLs. The reported results were checked through that register and corroborated with official CNA decisions/university pages; exact endpoints were independently cross-checked against the live Comisión Ingresa table.

Universidad de Los Lagos' current institutional accreditation expires on 9 September 2026. Whether it remains eligible after that date depends on a new CNA decision or legally effective extension not yet published in the sources reviewed.

The report addresses her basic medical professional title and PhD. Rheumatology-specialist certification is a separate issue: Decreto 174 says it operates “sin perjuicio de la aplicación de la normativa sobre especialidades y subespecialidades del área de la salud” (https://www.bcn.cl/leychile/navegar?idNorma=1221526).

UChile's published materials accept a passport and online document submission but do not expressly promise that a person abroad can complete every stage without Chilean residence or travel. The later presencial document check should be confirmed directly before she pays.
